description: Percentage of ‘journeys’ on Highways Agency motorways and A roads that are ‘on time’ by road section by rolling year is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by National Highways. The data presented shows the percentage of ‘journeys’ that are ‘on time’ by road section by rolling year. This data can be used to track the percentage of ‘journeys that are ‘on time’ for individual road sections (or ‘links’) over time where source comparability issues are not highlighted. Coverage: United Kingdom. The portal files it under the publisher National Highways. It offers 9 resource(s) in XLS. The portal shows 2026-08-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
